verdicts.reason: A: the cream circle is pulled off the product and stranded in the bottom-left corner, and the can floats empty on the orange. The Try It button nearly touches the right edge and crowds the headline, and there is dead space at the top. Still, the headline, subcopy and CTA read as one coherent row. B has the same detached circle, and the can is shrunk to an unreadable sliver. The headline and 'Out now.' are split by a huge gap, and the CTA floats on its own between them, so grouping and hierarchy fall apart.
